_layer: STATIC — the JSON the vision LLM must return for every raw image before any prompt is built.
instruction: Look at the raw product photo and the product-sheet row. Return ONLY this JSON. Use ids from the dataset tables; never invent new ids.

schema.brand_id: string — from brands.csv detect_keywords or sheet; '_default' if unknown
schema.product_description: one factual sentence: shape, colour, finish, packaging, visible text
schema.price_tier: value | mid | premium — from brand positioning + sheet price
schema.mood_id: chosen from: brand.mood_override > sheet.mood_override > category.default_moods (pick the one that best matches product colours)
schema.surface: chosen from category.surfaces filtered by mood.surfaces_preferred; must contrast with product colour
risks: e.g. small label text, reflective metal, transparent packaging

selection_rules: Priority: brand rules > sheet overrides > category defaults > studio default.
Surface must contrast with the product: dark product -> lighter surface (unless luxe_moody, then mid-tone with soft rim separation).
Props must match the chosen mood AND category; drop any prop listed in brand_donts.
Prefer props whose colours sit in the mood palette; never pick a prop the same colour as the product.
Never reuse the identical prop set for two SKUs of the same category in one batch — rotate.
